title: callista quadrangularis
intro: Callista quadrangularis, commonly known as the "Mukul tree" or "Gurjan", is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, and it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Callista quadrangularis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
